text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A day off. Thinking about doing some 
shopping at the mall, I was just about to 
turn off the TV, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You called, and here I pop up!? Hello 
there~! It's Nice Nature, the shopping 
district's PR Director♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Today on this live broadcast, I'll be 
sharing plenty of this shopping district's 
charm with you all! Please stay with me 
until the very end-cha♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The most popular item at this bakery run 
by a lovely smiling lady is the innovative 
Squid Ink Roll!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
One bite and your teeth are guaranteed to 
turn black! It's delicious and hilarious, 
an absolute masterpiece♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the greengrocer! Their grilled 
carrots are offered at an insanely cheap 
bargain price!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The special sauce matches the carrot's 
sweetness for a sweet and savory taste~. 
It tastes just like home cooking, making 
all your regrets and sadness blow right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, did that make you hungry? Well then, 
here's a bite—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding, not gonna give it to ya♪ If 
you want to eat it, come on over to the 
shopping district~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It might not be flashy or 'photogenic.' 
Even so—I'd really love for you to come 
see it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Young and old, men and women, everyone can 
smile here! That's what this shopping 
district is all about... It's so bright, 
sparkly, and warm!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you all come down here too, and 
put on a bright, sparkling smile?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—And that's all! This was Nice Nature, 
broadcasting live from the shopping 
district~! Bye-bye-cha~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bright, sparkling, and warm, huh... 
Heading over to the shopping district to 
unwind from work fatigue sounds like a 
pretty good idea.

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Mommy, this place is so much fun! Everyone 
is smiling!

text_block_list.name: Youth
text_block_list.text:
It's my first time eating this, but it 
tastes so nostalgic... I feel so 
relieved... tears are welling up~~!!

Well now, gotta thank the live broadcast 
for this!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
'Sup. Welcome to our humble shopping 
district~, just kidding.

hard

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well... yeah. I did think it wasn't very 
like me, though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't stand the thought of 
losing such a great shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah—... see, they recently built a shopping 
mall around this area, right? So customer 
traffic's been dropping.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
When I heard the shopping district was in 
a pinch, well... I couldn't just sit by 
and do nothing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Because honestly... it really is a 
wonderful place.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text:
—You lost your race? Then eat this! Cheer 
up and win the next one! Right?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Guy
text_block_list.text:
—Congrats on the win, Nature-chan! Ta-da! 
These are the 1st Place Commemorative 
Nature Cookies!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
They've always cheered on someone like me. 
...They've really helped me out so much.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So, I thought it was my turn to give back. 
Even if it's out of character, even if I 
had to push myself.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...If only I could repay them, even a 
little. Did I manage to... give back?
